stories.title: H2 — Timing-safe bridge secret comparison
stories.description: Replace direct string comparison of bridge secret with crypto.timingSafeEqual to prevent timing attacks.
acceptanceCriteria: auth.ts bridgeAuth uses crypto.timingSafeEqual instead of !== for secret comparison ✅
Both buffers are the same byte length before comparison (no length leak) ✅
A request with wrong secret still returns 401 ✅
A request with correct secret still passes through ✅
npm run build in packages/backend succeeds with 0 TypeScript errors ✅
npm test in packages/backend passes all 44 tests ✅

stories.title: H4 — Pin JWT algorithm to HS256
stories.description: Pass { algorithms: ['HS256'] } to jwt.verify() to prevent algorithm confusion attacks.
acceptanceCriteria: auth.ts adminAuth calls jwt.verify(token, jwtSecret, { algorithms: ['HS256'] }) ✅
npm run build in packages/backend succeeds with 0 TypeScript errors ✅
npm test in packages/backend passes all 44 tests ✅

stories.title: H3 — Rate limiting on all endpoints
stories.description: Add express-rate-limit middleware globally and tighter limits on sensitive routes.
acceptanceCriteria: express-rate-limit installed in packages/backend/package.json ✅
Global rate limit of 100 req/15min applied to all routes ✅
Tighter limit of 20 req/15min on /internal/bridge/* ✅
Tighter limit of 20 req/15min on /api/redemptions ✅
npm run build succeeds ✅
npm test passes all 44 tests ✅

stories.title: H1 — Separate BURNER_ROLE in CATRToken
stories.description: Add BURNER_ROLE so bridge minter cannot burn tokens.
acceptanceCriteria: CATRToken.sol defines BURNER_ROLE ✅
burn() restricted to onlyRole(BURNER_ROLE) ✅
Constructor accepts _burner and grants BURNER_ROLE ✅
deploy.ts passes _burner address ✅
Hardhat tests: mint works with MINTER_ROLE, burn requires BURNER_ROLE, minter burn reverts ✅ (14/14 passing)
REDEPLOY_REQUIRED.md written ✅
